text: Training ObjectivesCultivate all-round development in morality, intelligence, physical fitness, aesthetics and labor, master solid scientific and cultural foundations, ideological and political theories, basic theories of education and teaching, and disciplinary knowledge in the field of information technology, possess good humanistic qualities, scientific literacy and innovative consciousness, and have strong abilities in curriculum design and implementation, class construction and management, application of digital educational technology, and lifelong learning. High-quality educators with a spirit of craftsmanship and information literacy, who are capable of engaging in primary school information technology education and teaching, as well as online learning service guidance and other related work.Curriculum systemProfessional basic courses: including Basic psychology, Basic Education, Class Management, Professional Ethics for Teachers, Professional Development of Primary School Teachers, Application of Digital Educational Technology, Oral and Writing skills for Teachers, etc.Core professional courses: including Fundamentals of Programming, Graphic and Image Processing Technology, Animation Production, Digital Audio and Video Technology, Teaching Methods of Information Technology in Primary Schools, Teaching Design and Implementation in Primary Schools, Network Fundamentals and Information Security, Online Education Management, etc.Practical teaching: In line with real professional scenarios or working situations, it conducts basic teacher skills training, subject-specific basic skills training, simulation teaching, educational practice, graduation design and other practical training both on and off campus. It also conducts on-the-job internships in primary schools, educational training institutions, online education enterprises and other units.Development directionThe main employment directions for graduates are information technology teaching, teaching support and management positions in primary and secondary schools. Information technology training instructors and technical support positions in enterprises and public institutions; Positions such as photography, video recording, and film and television editing in the multimedia industry.
